summary: Explains that Ansible runs each role only once per play even if listed multiple times, unless the role parameters differ, and that there are two ways to force repeated runs.
questions: Why does my role only run once when I list it twice?
Does Ansible deduplicate roles in a play?

answer_card.title: Roles run once per play by default
answer_card.answer_md:
Ansible executes each role only **once** per play, even if you list it several times, unless the parameters on each definition differ. In this play `foo` runs once:
```yaml
- hosts: webservers
  roles:
    - foo
    - bar
    - foo
```
There are two options to force a role to run more than once.
